purpose: Teach: まとっ/ゆるやか/すえ/這い/とどまり/取り除い/くわしく/やしない

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが上品な雰囲気をまとってらしたわね
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather had such a refined presence about him, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm observation, gently nostalgic. Soft, approving tone. Speaks as if turning over a small, precious memory. Even pacing, no rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ゆるやかな坂道で自転車を漕いだよ
lines.en: Mom, I rode my bike down this really gentle slope.
lines.style: Excited but careful — eager to share a small discovery. Bright forward energy with the innocence of a six-year-old proud of noticing something. Clear and direct.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんの言葉のすえに大事な事があったわね
lines.en: Sho, there was something important hidden in what Grandpa said, wasn't there?
lines.style: Thoughtful, turning inward slightly. Gentle but present — the tone of a mother noticing her child has learned something. Pace slows slightly, like she's thinking while speaking.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんが床を這いずって遊んで下さったよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa got down on the floor and played with me.
lines.style: Pure delight, unguarded. The brightness of a child remembering tenderness. Small and genuine laugh underneath the words. No performance, just happiness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんがお家にとどまりたいって仰ったわ
lines.en: Sho, Grandpa said he wanted to stay home with us.
lines.style: Quiet, significant. The delivery of something that matters more than the words alone suggest. Calm but slightly weighted, like she's letting him understand something true.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんがぼくのまつ毛のゴミを取り除いて下さったよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa took something out of my eye — there was something in my eyelash.
lines.style: Tender recall, softly marveling. The wonder of a child in the kindness of an ordinary gesture. Gentle pace, no urgency. Trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、くわしくお祖父ちゃんに教えてもらいましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's ask Grandpa to tell us more about that, shall we?
lines.style: Gentle invitation, not a command. Warm and collaborative — speaking as a partner in curiosity with her son. Encouraging without pushing. Light, present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、自分のお小遣いをやしないに使うよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm going to save up my allowance for it.
lines.style: Earnest, small voice with quiet determination. The sincerity of a child making a decision he means. No boasting, just resolve. Steady delivery, trailing into commitment.
